message.content: {"is_bug": true, "summary": "Training crashed on the first NN fold with a shape mismatch in the deep tower: the constructed attention representation has dimension 32 (CLS token plus mean-pooled tokens, each emb_dim=16) while the first Linear layer expects only emb_dim=16 as budgeted in tower_in (2*d + emb_dim). Input 256x406 could not be multiplied by weight 390x256, so no model was trained or saved and no metric was produced.", "metric": null, "lower_is_better": false, "code_summary": "Pipeline engineers ordinal/binary/nominal features plus interaction and coupon-venue affinity features, fits a median imputer, categorical vocabulary indexer, and smoothed OOF-style target encoders for categorical combos (all fit only on training folds). Model is a DCN with cross layers, per-feature embeddings, a transformer-style attention token mixer, and a deep tower feeding a shared head plus a gated mixture-of-experts head, trained with label-smoothed BCE under AdamW + cosine schedule and early stopping on fold accuracy. A HistGradientBoostingClassifier is trained on the same engineered matrix, OOF predictions from both learners drive a grid search over blend weight and decision threshold, then all components are refit on full training data and a bundle (preprocessing, encoders, NN state dicts, GBDT, threshold, label map) is persisted for fresh-process prediction outputting row_id,prediction."}
message.reasoning_content:
The bug: attention output dim mismatch. In `_attn_repr`, pooled = concat of cls (emb_dim) and mean (emb_dim) -> 2*emb_dim = 32. But tower_in = 2*d + emb_dim where d = n_num + emb_dim*n_cat. So the expected attn dim is emb_dim (16), but actual is 32. Mismatch: 406 vs 390 = difference 16. Yes, attn returns 32 instead of 16.

So is_bug true, metric null, lower_is_better false (accuracy).
